question: Do the original finite stationary semigroups converge, first in radial cutoff j at fixed n and then in the specified anchored volume n, to the R-512 minimal-form semigroup in local two-point correlations uniformly on every compact nonnegative time interval?

scope.model: Exact PAH-001 functional and original directed PH/LK/AP/TR rates and partial domains through the pinned OMC-018 source chain. No Hamiltonian, generator, state or carrier change.
scope.parameters: K=2, M_s=1, epsilon=1/2, beta=nu=1, m2=theta=0, all other displayed OMC-016 couplings one.
scope.geometry: Original OMC-004 two-row relational G_n, n>=2, 2(n+2) vertices; terminal unsplit square and label-only anchors retained. No physical dimension, length or volume assignment.
scope.state: Full labelled all-Q counting Gibbs mu_nj with w_Q=Z_Q/Z; fixed-n radial limit nu_n and specified anchored R-510 nu_infty. No quotient, prior, Jacobian or conditional state selection.
scope.regulator_order: h_j=2^-j, R_j=2^j, M_j=2^(2j), j>=0. First j at every fixed n, then the original anchored n exhaustion. No diagonal, reversed, joint or other regulator limit.
scope.time: Original external unaccelerated Markov time t>=0 with finite stationary initial law and no terminal conditioning. No infinite-time, quantum-real-time, proper-time or Lorentzian interpretation.

objects_and_comparison.D: Exactly R-511/R-512 real bounded gauge-invariant globally amplitude-l1-Lipschitz finite-prefix cylinder algebra; constants included. No graph-core assumption.
objects_and_comparison.S_nj: Direct same-observable evaluation f(r,z) at r=h_j ell on G_n, retaining every original read label and old-coordinate formula. This linear map is defined only on cylinder representatives in D and is not claimed an isometry or a bounded map on completed H.
objects_and_comparison.n_comparison: Neutral retention of the same prefix Lambda_m and root labels for all n>=N(f,g)=max(2,m(f)+2,m(g)+2). No exterior conditional averaging or replacement of original boundary interactions.
objects_and_comparison.finite_semigroup: P_nj(t)=exp(t L_nj), where L_nj is the SAME finite original reversible generator. No truncation of its root set or fitted rates.
objects_and_comparison.target_semigroup: Let K_min be the nonnegative self-adjoint operator represented by the exact R-512 minimal closed nonnegative form Ebar on H. T_min(t)=exp(-t K_min). Derive its Markov/conservative properties when used; do not assume equality with another extension or maximal jump form.
objects_and_comparison.target_quantifiers: For every f,g in D and every finite T>=0: for each n>=N(f,g), a continuous C_n(f,g;.) exists with sup_{0<=t<=T}|C_nj-C_n|->0 as j->infinity; then sup_{0<=t<=T}|C_n-C_min|->0 as n->infinity. Both passages and identification with the minimal-form target must be proved.
objects_and_comparison.topology_boundary: Local stationary two-point correlation convergence, compact-time uniform. Not assumed strong operator convergence between different Hilbert spaces, multi-time path-law convergence, a Feller process, a common real-time automorphism or a physical limit.

proof_obligations: Revalidate source pins, the exact finite semigroup and state, and the spectral representation of the R-512 minimal closed form without importing a physical time interpretation.
Establish a support-dependent but j,n-uniform compact-time equicontinuity estimate for local correlations using original weighted energy bounds, not a divergent pointwise rate envelope.

Prove fixed-n j convergence with the declared sampling maps, including endpoint domains, unbounded label rates and the vanishing original radial part; a local-generator residual alone is insufficient.

Prove the anchored n temporal limit and identify the selected extension as the MINIMAL R-512 form. Supply a generalized Mosco liminf/recovery argument, a genuine operator-core/resolvent theorem, or an independently complete equivalent proof.
Separate a proof-route missing premise from an exact counterexample to the PAH target. In particular, a possible minimal/maximal-domain gap is not automatically a PAH no-go.

Reproduce exact primary, non-importing independent and hostile checks, with meaningful Lean consequences where feasible; distinguish inherited analytic inputs and internal verification from external review.
prohibited_shortcuts: No rate/functional/mobility/finite-part/state/time change, counterterm, time acceleration, conditional generator averaging, fixed-R_max bypass or new finite carrier.
No inference of semigroup selection from closability, form-core density, pointwise generator consistency or static Gibbs convergence alone.
No assumption that a form core is an operator graph core, or that the minimal closed form equals the maximal jump form.
No Q3LOCK or TECT-YM result imported as a PAH premise; no phasewise or source-dependent direct-sum rescue.
